main_body: wooden dresser with four drawers and items on top
top_band: light tan/brown wood surface from row 6 to row 13 (with small objects resting on it)
evidence: Rows 6-11 form the main top surface (tan brown), row 12 is a bright highlight front-edge line, row 13 is the front lip of the top slab, row 14 is a dark eave shadow beneath the overhang, and rows 15-30 form the vertical front face with four bevelled/recessed drawers.

style.evidence: While the wood ramp uses about 5 brown tones and includes small clutter props on top, the drawer faces and top surface are completely flat fills of solid colour with no wood grain or speckle, and the piece is framed on the sides and bottom by a stark pure-black (0,0,0) outline rather than dark material tones.
